model: static extensible isotropic Kirchhoff centerline rod energy; no torsion/shear DOFs
material_assumptions: effective independent EA and EI; not measured or calibrated; rest curvature zero
rest_length_treatment: initial segment lengths times stated ratio, except segments with both nodes fixed use initial length
packing_scope: pair distances within only declared covered cross sections; rotational and translational world motion free
boundary_method: fixed node variables eliminated exactly; fixed 3-node end ranges impose outlet tangent
optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B on stiffness-preconditioned free position DOFs
raw_output_postprocessing: none; all original material nodes exported directly
equation: U=0.5 sum EA/l0*(length-l0)^2 +0.5 sum EI/lbar*|t_next-t_prev|^2 -sum mass*g dot x +0.5 k_c sum relu(contact_margin-clearance)^2 +0.5 k_p sum (member_distance-rest_distance)^2
